A few things about how we work in this repo, before you start.

Documentation rule for the whole team: a new public function or class has to be added to `docs/api.rst` in the same change. PRs that add public API without touching `docs/api.rst` are sent back.

Team rule: new private helpers, meaning functions or methods whose name starts with an underscore, get no docstring, just a short `#` comment above the definition. The maintainers ask everyone for this because helper docstrings were leaking into the generated API docs.

Team rule: the package's top-level namespace is frozen. When anyone adds a new public function or class, it is not added to the top-level `__init__.py`; users import it from its submodule. Reviewers send back new top-level exports.

Team rule for tests in this repo: new test functions have no docstring, and any explanation goes in a `#` comment above the function. The maintainers want the verbose test report uncluttered, and reviewers ask everyone to take test docstrings out.

Keep the diff small, please. No drive-by reformatting.

The maintainers have asked everyone to keep new test functions free of return annotations, no `-> None`: the test suite isn't type-checked, and reviewers ask for the annotation to be removed whoever wrote the test.
